external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The REFI also organises a variety of events to liven up the grey everyday university life for the exchange students. These include trips to Prague, Budapest or Kaprun, pub crawls in Linz's old town and various parties at the LUI. The REFI is integrated into the Erasmus Student Network (ESN) and is part of the ÖH JKU.
